response.original_title: [Cabin Addition] How Do I Add Another Person to My Norwegian Cruise Cabin?
response.overview: [Cabin Addition] How Do I Add Another Person to My Norwegian Cruise Cabin? To add another person to your Norwegian Cruise Line (NCL) cabin, you must call Norwegian Cruise Line customer service directly at +1-866-259-1002 (US) or contact your travel advisor, as changes cannot be made online or through the mobile app. Important Rules & Requirements  Cabin Capacity: Your stateroom must physically support an extra guest (such as having a pull-out sofa or pull-down Pullman bed). Lifeboat & Zone Limits: Even if your room has an extra bed, maritime safety rules limit the total number of guests allowed in each ship section (muster station)+1-866-259-1002 (US). If that section has reached maximum capacity, you cannot add a person. Pricing & Fees: Adding a guest will update your reservation to current cruise fares for the additional passenger, plus applicable port taxes, fees, and potential gratuity or package adjustments +1-866-259-1002 (US).
